scope: Every remaining file under src, including canonical assets and executable wrappers. Consumers include literal imports (static and dynamic), URL-resolved entries, and explicit program/source path references in runtime, scripts and tests. Computed dynamic/spawn sites are listed separately for review.

dispositions.core: Deliberately core-owned implementation; physical relocation is Plan 03.
dispositions.assembly: Domain implementation already extracted. Core retains configured binding; centralize in Plan 02 and remove legacy path in Plan 06.
dispositions.legacy: Compatibility forward only; production implementations use public APIs. Migrate remaining test/legacy consumers in Plan 06.
dispositions.program: Work-owned executable implementation behind an installed path wrapper; resolve program paths in Plans 02/05 and remove wrapper in Plan 06.
dispositions.asset: Canonical asset installed by core. Physical asset migration and installed-copy synchronization are Plan 07.
